s1.ptxt: Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
For M/T model, place gear shift lever in “Neutral” and apply parking brake.
For A/T model, place select lever in “P” and apply parking brake.
Stop engine and turn off all electric switches.
Disconnect air bypass valve control hose No.4 (1) from check valve (2).
Connect special tools to air bypass valve control hose No.4 (1).
Run engine at specified idle speed.
Read vacuum gauge. Negative pressure should be within specification.

spec.title: Negative pressure specification (at sea level)
spec.ptxt: –73 to –59 kPa (–0.7 to –0.6 kgf/cm2, –10.58 to –8.55 psi, –0.73 to –0.59 bar) at specified idle speed

s1.ptxt: Disconnect special tools from air bypass valve control hose No.4.
Connect air bypass valve control hose No.4 to check valve.
